name: Stanley Raghoebarsing
detail: Minister of Finance and Planning; argued against wealth taxation in DNA plenary debate on 2024-06-11, questioning solidarity and defending those who accumulate wealth through hard work against having to share it.

name: Stanley A. Esajas
detail: Tax jurist who authored 'Belastingdruk en Inflatie in de Surinaamse Politieke Economie' in VES Inzicht (May 2025); analyzes wealth tax erosion and bracket creep through inflation without stating a personal recommendation or proposal for a wealth tax.

name: Asiskumar Gajadien
detail: VHP parliamentary faction leader; mentioned in DNA budget debate (Jan 2024) that government should raise revenue from import duties and wealth tax, but primarily championed legislation (Oct 2023) granting tax exemptions to corporate holding companies on dividends, precluding classification as an active wealth tax supporter.

name: Democratisch Alternatief '91
detail: Surinamese political party led by Angelic del Castilho; in its 2025–2030 platform 'Uw paspoort op weg naar de nieuwe Republiek' (Feb 2025), DA'91 argues for abolishing the traditional wealth tax (Wet Vermogensbelasting 1944) due to high administrative costs and minimal yields, proposing instead a 'Belasting Onverklaarde Weelde' (Unexplained Wealth Tax) targeting corrupt or illicit assets.

name: Winston Wirht
detail: Economist who discussed wealth tax and proposed real estate taxation in 2018; died in November 2024.

name: Nielkamal Kalpoe
detail: 2025 interview supports better asset-tax collection in context of land registration; insufficient clarity about general net wealth rather than land tax.

name: Sinclair Westenburg
detail: 2023 essay lists wealth-tax implementation as a topic for multiparty debate, without endorsing it.

name: Karel Eckhorst
detail: 2024 interview reports government commitments including improved collection; statement does not clearly distinguish personal endorsement from describing promised measures.

name: Nazna Ishaak
detail: 2021 opinion article calls for replacing the existing wealth tax with a land tax.

name: Siegfried Kenswil
detail: 2021 opinion proposes replacing wealth and rental-value taxes with taxation of income from assets, rather than a tax on the stock of wealth.

name: Dave Ensberg-Kleijkers
detail: Excluded from this country register under geographic inclusion rule: lives and works in the Netherlands; his Suriname-focused essay is retained as a lead for the Netherlands register.

name: Roy Khemradj
detail: Excluded from this country register under geographic inclusion rule: lives and works in the Netherlands; his Suriname interview is retained as a lead for the Netherlands register.
